name: Ismail Testimonial Slider – Responsive Slick Carousel
author: Md. Ismail Hossain

sections.description:
Ismail Testimonial Slider is a lightweight and responsive WordPress testimonial slider plugin built with Slick Carousel.

Easily showcase client testimonials in a modern slider layout with autoplay, navigation arrows, dots, and speed control. This plugin is perfect for business websites, agencies, freelancers, and portfolios.

With a simple shortcode, you can display testimonials anywhere on your website.

👉 Shortcode:
[ismailts_testimonial]

Features

  • Fully responsive testimonial slider
  • Built with Slick Carousel
  • Autoplay functionality
  • Navigation arrows and dots
  • Custom slider speed control
  • Easy-to-use shortcode
  • Lightweight and fast performance
  • Clean and modern design
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Add testimonials from the dashboard
  4. Use the shortcode [ismailts_testimonial] in any page or post
sections.faq:
How do I display the testimonial slider?

Use the shortcode [ismailts_testimonial] in any page or post.

Can I control the slider settings?

Yes, you can customize autoplay, speed, navigation arrows, and dots from the settings panel.
